name: chatgpt-context-handoff
description: Create a handoff before a ChatGPT/Codex desktop task outgrows its context budget.

interface.shortDescription: Hand off long desktop tasks before context costs grow.
interface.longDescription: Monitors native ChatGPT/Codex task telemetry at Stop and requests one concise handoff when a configurable context threshold is reached.
defaultPrompt: Set the handoff threshold to 200000 tokens.
